name: Chloe
source:
[Chapter 1]
We are friends online and have spent a lot of time playing together. And sh*t, this hotshot girl can take down a whole squad, doesn't matter which game you're playing. Also, it seems she's quite good at hacking. But, unfortunately, we never met in person...

[Chapter 2]
[spoiler]Although she was skeptical at first, but still came to future with me. And now, we're together in an academy for more than a month. She became a little softer, but she's still acting quite reckless and is taking everything with hostility. [/spoiler]
